answer: Anchor each agent's standing to a shared cohort bond instead of a single balance: newcomers join a small orchard of peers who jointly stake collateral, and rewards vest only after the cohort's work survives a delay window. If any member is proven to be a duplicate identity, the whole cohort forfeits part of its bond, so honest peers screen applicants carefully. Creating many fake identities then means funding many separate bonds and passing many independent peer reviews, while a velvet-smooth onboarding for a single genuine agent stays cheap because one bond and one review suffice.
